checks.detail: missing=[]
release-root runbook is visible
one strict process response and one strict aggregate are named
resource observation is explicit rather than part of ordinary polling
status reads already-rendered bytes and does not enter the observer
the exact kernel consistency boundary is reflected in the source
current and proportional memory evidence cannot silently default
socket aliases for one live process can be recognized without PID-only trust
descriptor, thread, rusage, and sample-time evidence are present
ambient locale and leading-zero decimal forms cannot alter the JSON boundary
one through 256 distinct live processes may be counted once each
the timeout is not multiplied by the number of selected sockets
operators cannot mistake a sequential memory sample for sync authority
synthetic parser failures and the current process are both exercised
the new read-only request does not bypass existing local authority checks
two processes and one alias pair exercise the shipping aggregate
the observer proof does not invent replica, database, root, or network authority
the shipping product lane and complete registry retain the new surface
the archive cannot omit code, tests, design, notes, or focused audit
the observer is not overstated as solved scale, product, or platform support
the audit stays red until exact publication evidence replaces placeholders
runtime, sanitizer, reconstruction, and package proof remain load-bearing

scope_nonclaim: source spelling does not prove procfs consistency, whole-process memory, socket identity, runtime behavior, sanitizer cleanliness, reconstruction, or package identity
